channel.title: NodeBox Appcast
channel.description: Most recent changes with links to updates.

item.title: Version 3.1.0
item.description:
• NodeBox now runs natively on Apple Silicon Macs.
  • The macOS app is signed and notarized, so it opens without security warnings.
  • Movie export uses a native Apple Silicon build of ffmpeg.
  • Python nodes run on Jython 2.7.4.

item.title: Version 3.0.53
item.description: • Windows: copy and paste use the Ctrl key again instead of the Meta key.

item.title: Version 3.0.52
item.description:
• You can export movies on macOS Catalina and later.
  • Fixed a bug when option-dragging.
